title: Restoration Estimator & Claims Specialist
description:
This is a remote position.
Our client is looking for a Restoration Estimator & Claims Specialist to manage restoration estimates and insurance claims from initial write-up and documentation through approval and final payment. They operate in the property restoration industry, providing comprehensive solutions for property damage, remediation, reconstruction, and recovery.
This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with hands-on Xactimate experience and a strong understanding of property insurance claims. The successful candidate will prepare accurate estimates, assemble complete claim files, communicate with adjusters and clients, manage supplements and discrepancies, and maintain consistent follow-up until every file reaches closure.
The position plays a significant role in the company's cash flow, managing an estimated $2-4 million in written and collected volume annually.
Responsibilities

• Prepare complete and accurate Xactimate invoices for restoration projects within 24 hours of job completion.

• Create accurate sketches and scope documentation according to restoration industry and insurance carrier standards.

• Compile supporting documentation, including photos, moisture logs, signed service agreements, and other required claim records.

• Submit complete estimate and documentation packages to insurance carriers or adjusters within 48 hours of job completion.

• Maintain a structured follow-up schedule for all active insurance claims.

• Track each claim throughout review, approval, and payment until the outstanding balance is collected in full.

• Identify and address claim discrepancies, supplemental estimate requirements, and adjuster objections that may delay payment.

• Communicate directly with clients regarding their financial responsibility on insurance-related projects.

• Manage invoicing, collections, and payment follow-up for private-pay projects.

• Maintain detailed and accurate records of all communications with clients, insurance carriers, adjusters, and internal team members.

• Monitor and respond to both shared company and individual email inboxes.

• Collaborate closely with Project Managers to ensure project scope, documentation, estimates, and claim status remain aligned.

• Serve as a professional point of contact for clients and insurance representatives throughout the claims process

Requirements

• Hands-on experience using Xactimate for estimating and sketching.

• Xactimate Level 2 (Proficiency) certification is required.

• Previous experience with insurance claim closure within property restoration, construction, or a closely related field.

• Strong understanding of the property insurance claims lifecycle, including estimate/invoice submission, supplements, adjuster negotiations, and payment collection.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of active files and consistently meet deadlines.

• Strong customer service skills with a professional phone and email presence.

• Comfortable managing shared email inboxes and collaborating with Project Managers and administrative teams.

Qualifications
The following qualifications are preferred but not required:

• Xactimate Level 3 (Mastery) certification.

• Experience handling claims involving water damage, mold remediation, fire restoration, reconstruction, or abatement.

• Experience with restoration CRM or job-management platforms such as DASH, Encircle, CompanyCam, Jobber, or similar systems.

• IICRC certifications.

Benefits

• Full-time position.
• 100% remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
• Flexible working hours for estimate preparation and file completion, provided required turnaround times are consistently achieved.
